title: Arthritis News : Immune Tolerance Induced by Chicken Type II Collagen as Treatment for RA
abstract: Zhang et al (Arthritis Care & Research 2008; 59(7): 905) present the results of a blinded clinical trial of chicken Type II collagen (CCII) vs. Although the induction of immune tolerance with such an inexpensive and presumably non-toxic agent as type II collagen would be a benefit to RA therapy, its use cannot be recommended by this study for a variety of reasons. Finally, there is no evidence from the study that any independent effect of CCII on RA signs and symptoms, if it were to exist, was through a modulating effect on immune tolerance.
